::: {.lead-note}

I have been a civil servant in the Provincial Government of North Sulawesi since
2015, and have held procurement roles across the full cycle of public buying:
asset management, procurement officer, commitment-making official, selection
working group, and finally leading the provincial unit responsible for
procurement advisory and technical guidance. That institutional experience is the
origin of both my professional practice and my research interest in how public
resources are actually allocated.

:::

## Government of North Sulawesi

Home agency: Provincial Civil Service Agency (Badan Kepegawaian Daerah Provinsi
Sulawesi Utara, Type A), Manado.

[Internal Procurement Facilitator, Provincial Training Institution (LPPBJ)]{.role}

::: {.org}

Registered internal facilitator for the North Sulawesi provincial procurement
training institution, delivered through the Regional Human Resources Development
Agency (BPSDMD). Teaches the four competency subjects, from procurement
planning to contract management and self-managed procurement, across all four
levels of the national framework, and serves as coach and evaluator.

::: {.org}

Procurement Bureau, Regional Secretariat (Biro Pengadaan Barang/Jasa Setda), North Sulawesi Province. Led provincial advisory and technical guidance in public

governments, and villages.
